title: Klickitat
assessment: One substantive ethnographic block with attached heading, then link labels and categories. More genuine sparse-layout cases exist outside strict dictionary coverage; do not equate unresolved with good.

title: Donja Dubica
assessment: One village sentence, empty population heading, a football-club listing, links and bibliography; bibliography/category concatenation artifact. Sparse layout, but contains a meaningful short inventory. Not part of 44-ID proposal.

title: Prvenstvo Njemačke u softbolu
assessment: Useful year-to-winner list, no narrative paragraph ordering. Not category garbage; list objective deserves separate judgment, not automatic exclusion across tasks.

title: Popis E brojeva
assessment: Multiple numeric additive-list blocks can have intrinsic numeric ordering; no narrative prose, but meaningful structured information. Do not blanket-filter as metadata.

title: Ivo Škrabalo
assessment: Award fragment, bibliography and extensive categories, no two prose units. Deliberately excluded from automatic narrow bucket because useful award fragment/ambiguous references remain.

title: Rab (grad)
assessment: Many substantive history paragraphs plus economy/notable-person inventories. Meaningful list flag is not evidence of overall task failure.

title: Joe's Garage
assessment: Track, act/side and personnel listings with one explanatory sentence. Meaningful album ordering and attribution, not only category furniture; no blanket list removal.

title: Alyxia
assessment: One short real sentence, long taxonomic inventory and synonyms. Lists are useful information, not prose paragraphs; uncertain/list bucket appropriately separate.

title: Velered kralja Dmitra Zvonimira s lentom i Danicom
assessment: Multiple genuine wearing/protocol prose blocks plus names/citations. Initial narrative block lacks a detector verb and is undercounted; at-least-two bucket still correct.

title: Sovke
assessment: Five clear anatomical/ecological prose blocks. Empty parentheses in the opening and unknown category Neoaves do not erase multi-paragraph content; source noise separate.

title: HKD Ljuba
assessment: Four narrative blocks interleaved with headings. Unrecognized Sekcije/Aktivnosti headings inflate uncertainty but not the true prose count failure rate.

title: Evanđelje po Tomi
assessment: Three substantive argument paragraphs with contrast cues, followed by notes/categories. Useful reordering despite metadata tail.

title: Prva hrvatska liga u bejzbolu 2012.
assessment: Denoising list control: scores and fixture labels are structured content. Many empty fixture blocks and a 2010-dated line in 2012 context warrant separate source review; not a zero-prose all-task rejection.

title: Renzo Agasso
assessment: Denoising control: a real biography plus meaningful bibliography. Preserve lists; do not equate a bibliography block with useless metadata.

title: Clupea
assessment: Denoising control: taxonomic definition and species/authorship list. Useful named entities despite no detected finite-verb prose; not category-only.

title: 60. pr. Kr.
assessment: Denoising control: dated events and regional snippets. Year-led opening is structured historical text, not automatically a numbered-list marker.

title: Jadranka Brnčić
assessment: Link-only tail plus writer category, no narrative. This is reference furniture, not strictly category-and-heading-only. Keep separate from the reordering proposal; corrupted URL restoration could be underdetermined.
